prior_blocker.resolution: Explicit opt-in BoundedIndicatorDelta performs checked arithmetic followed by configured bounds clamping; strict legacy constructors/tags remain unchanged. Modern tasks exclusively use bounded indicator effects. The design now requires lower/upper/exact and nonzero/negative bounds, invalid state, reference, overflow, atomic rollback, cross-actor appraisal and installed repeated-work/rest completion controls. Supply costs remain charged when benefits cap, with pre-start disclosure and actual result reporting.

strongest_objection: Adding an Effect ADT constructor could otherwise bypass observer ownership, omit an exhaustive match, or change legacy encodings. Revision 1 explicitly covers each known match, preserves strict branches and old tags, adds a unique wire tag, bumps the experimental package to 0.2.0 as breaking, updates consumer locks, and requires forged-appraisal and byte-identical legacy controls. No unresolved design blocker found.
